description: This file implements the NetworkManager class, which manages network connectivity status, handles network change events, and determines network access behavior based on connection cost information.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: A class responsible for monitoring network status changes and determining network access behavior.

methods.name: NetworkManager
methods.description: Constructor that subscribes to network status change events.

methods.name: ~NetworkManager
methods.description: Destructor that unsubscribes from network status change events.

methods.name: GetNetworkAccessBehavior
methods.description: Determines current network access behavior based on connection profile and connectivity level.

methods.name: OnNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Event handler invoked when network status changes; triggers behavior update.

methods.name: ConvertCostInfoToBehavior
methods.description: Converts connection cost information into a network access behavior enum.
